name: Charity Pringle Mekeel

death.place: home of a daughter, Lehman Twp., Luzerne Co., PA

bioAdditions: Harvey Book p.1020 says Charity was a daughter of James Pringle, who settled about 1797-98 in the part of Plymouth Twp. that is now Jackson Twp. She married Oliver Mekeel (d. 11 Oct 1847). She was born on 31 Jan 1800 and died at a daughter's home in Lehman Twp. on 12 Mar 1899, in her hundredth year. Her son was Lewis McKeel or Mekeel, and his daughter Cora married George Nesbitt (S1).

conflicts.foundValue: FamilySearch L4WX-HKC merges Charity (Gould) Pringle, wife of Benjamin Pringle (b. 16 Feb 1800, d. 19 Jan 1883 Lehman), with 'Charity Pringle Mekeel'
conflicts.assessment: These are two different women born within weeks of each other in 1800 who both died in Lehman Twp.: Charity Gould, Benjamin's wife (d. 1883), and Charity Pringle, James's daughter and Oliver Mekeel's wife (d. 1899). Keep them separate. See also H0435.

openQuestionsNew: Father 'James Pringle' (Harvey p.1020, Jackson Twp. c.1797-98): which James on the site is he? He may be the brother of Samuel Pringle (I282608055448).
